title: Partner findings checked against actual PPO and sensor evidence
summary: Independent checks reject the stuck-learning-rate and missing-reset hypotheses while confirming severe quiet action chatter. Terrain counterexamples identify three narrow sensor-transport defects for a versioned successor. The next PPO proposal prioritizes quiet temporal smoothing with gradient/KL diagnostics; no gate is relaxed.
